title: Complete the Work locale catalog
description: Extend the existing dependency-free typed locale catalog with one complete WorkCatalog and use it across the current /work surface. Catalog every Gateship-authored visible label, title, description, status, button, placeholder, empty state, fallback and pluralized count rendered by WorkSurface and its existing Backlog, Diagnostics, issue review, proposal inbox/history, issue specification and issue intake panels. Keep the existing en-US wording and behavior as the production baseline and add complete pt-BR equivalents. Thread the already-selected Locale/catalog through those existing components without adding a second context, state store or translation runtime. Locale-sensitive dates and numbers on this surface must use the selected locale. Preserve operator-authored titles, scopes, evidence, verification commands and proposal text verbatim; also preserve issue/run/finding identifiers, provider or analyzer names, Git values and shell commands as factual data rather than translating them. Extend the existing static-render tests in place with representative populated, empty and actionable /work states in both locales, asserting exact product-owned labels and that authored values survive unchanged. Do not add a wording grep, snapshot test or score. Update HANDOFF.md only to record that /work is cataloged and that /settings plus onboarding remain before a production locale selector. Preserve run authority, proposal promotion, diagnostic advisory behavior, bounded lists and every existing form/action contract. Out of scope: /settings, onboarding, locale selection or persistence, browser-language inference, server/API/error localization, new endpoints, dependencies, panels, routes, database or runtime lifecycle changes.
